findings.detail: The parser/validator attributed the principal/par currency marker or country currency to fair_value_currency even though the source fair value column is dollar-denominated.

rationale: FX02 is not a real data error for these rows. In the source SOI header, foreign symbols such as AUD, EUR, and GBP sit under Principal Amount, Par Value or Shares, while Cost and Fair Value are separate columns; the country subtotals for Australia, Canada, United Kingdom, and Netherlands explicitly show dollar signs for cost and fair value. Canada has no CAD marker on the row at all and its subtotal fair value is also dollar-denominated. The non-USD fair_value_currency values therefore reflect unit attribution by extraction/validation, not source fair values reported in foreign currency.
